name: claude-code-stranger-danger
description: Readers don't act; actors don't read. A Claude Code plugin that keeps untrusted text away from agents that hold a shell.

plugins.name: stranger-danger
plugins.description: Read-only reader agents plus deny-only hooks: web tools only for the web reader, untrusted and quarantine folders only for their readers, secret paths for no one, and no fetch-and-run launchers.
